entries.source_en: Hi, glad to meet you!<0xFB>"That's unfriendly of you.\nHow about saying hi back?<0xFB>So, come on, tell me about\nyourself.<0xFB>I'd love to hear your profile!
Tell me something good about\nyourself. What's your profile?
entries.comparison_fr: Dis-moi quelque chose sur toi.\nQuel est ton profil ?

entries.source_en:
A profile is written using four
words or phrases.<0xFB>There're plenty of words to choose
from for your profile.<0xFB>The words and phrases are placed
in several convenient groups.<0xFB>First, choose a group, then choose
a word or phrase.<0xFB>"It's easier than it sounds.
Why don't you try it?
entries.comparison_fr:
Un profil s’écrit avec quatre mots
ou phrases.\pIl y a plein de mots pour faire
ton profil.\pLes mots et phrases sont rangés en
plusieurs groupes pratiques.\pD’abord, choisis un groupe, puis un
mot ou une phrase.\p…C’est plus simple qu’il n’y paraît.
Pourquoi ne pas essayer ?

entries.source_en: Aww" Don't be like that.\nYou can tell me your profile.
entries.comparison_fr: Allons… Ne sois pas comme ça.\nTu peux me dire ton profil.

entries.source_en: Oh, you've decided not to?\nYou're fickle, aren't you?
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, tu as changé d'avis ?\nTu es du genre capricieux, non ?

entries.source_en: Would you like to change your\nprofile?
What are you like now?\nI'd really like to know.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu es comment maintenant ?\nJ’aimerais vraiment savoir.

entries.source_en: Okay, you like your profile the\nway it is.<0xFB>I think so, too.
entries.comparison_fr: D'accord, tu aimes ton profil\ntel qu'il est.\pJe le pense aussi.

entries.source_en: Hmhm"<0xFB>Your profile really says something\nabout who you are.<0xFB>Now that I know you better, it \nmakes us better friends than ever!
entries.comparison_fr: Hmhm…\pTon profil en dit vraiment long\nsur qui tu es.\pMaintenant que je te connais mieux,\nnous sommes encore plus amis !

entries.source_en: Oh, I've heard that before"<0xFB>My cousin, who lives far away,\nalways used to say that, I think.
entries.comparison_fr: Oh, j’ai déjà entendu ça…\pMa cousine, loin d’ici, disait\nsouvent ça, je crois.

entries.source_en: Please tell me more about\nyourself next time!
entries.comparison_fr: Dis-m’en plus sur toi la prochaine\nfois !

entries.source_en: I'm the Day-Care Man.<0xFB>I help take care of the precious\nPokémon of Trainers.<0xFB>If you'd like me to raise your\nPokémon, have a word with my wife.

Ah, it's you!<0xFB>We were raising your Pokémon, and\nmy goodness, were we surprised!<0xFB>Your Pokémon had an Egg!<0xFB>We don't know how it got there,\nbut your Pokémon had it.<0xFB>You do want it, yes?
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, c’est toi !\pOn élevait tes Pokémon et… quelle\nsurprise !\pTes Pokémon ont eu un Œuf !\pOn ne sait pas comment, mais tes\nPokémon l’ont fait.\pTu le veux, n’est-ce pas ?

entries.source_en: Ah, it's you! Good to see you.\nYour <0xFD>Á's doing fine.
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, c’est toi ! Ravi de te voir.\nTon {STR_VAR_1} va très bien.

entries.source_en: You have no room for it"\nCome back when you've made room.
entries.comparison_fr: Tu n’as pas de place… Reviens quand\ntu auras de la place.

entries.source_en: <0xFD>À received the Egg from\nthe Day-Care Man.
Ah, it's you! Your <0xFD>Á and\n<0xFD>Â are doing fine.
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, c'est toi ! Ton <0xFD><0x02> et\nton <0xFD><0x03> se portent bien.

entries.source_en: I really will keep it.\nYou do want this, yes?
entries.comparison_fr: Je vais vraiment le garder.\nC'est ce que tu veux, oui ?

entries.source_en: I'm the Day-Care Lady.<0xFB>We can raise Pokémon for you.<0xFB>Would you like us to raise one?
entries.comparison_fr: Je suis la Mémé Pension.\pOn peut élever des Pokémon pour toi.\pVeux-tu qu’on en élève un ?

entries.source_en: Which Pokémon should we raise for\nyou?
Fine, we'll raise your <0xFD>Á\nfor a while.<0xFB>Come back for it later.
entries.comparison_fr: D’accord, on va élever ton\n{STR_VAR_1} un moment.\pReviens le récupérer plus tard.

entries.source_en: We can raise two of your Pokémon.<0xFB>Would you like us to raise one\nmore Pokémon for you?
entries.comparison_fr: Nous pouvons élever deux de tes\nPokémon.\pVeux-tu nous confier un autre\nPokémon à élever ?

entries.source_en: My husband was looking for you.
Will you take back the other one,\ntoo?
Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you.<0xFB>Your Pokémon can only be doing\ngood!
entries.comparison_fr: Ah, c’est toi !\nContent de te voir.\pTes Pokémon ne peuvent qu’aller\nbien !

entries.source_en: Your Pokémon party is full.\nMake room, then come see me.
entries.comparison_fr: Ton équipe est pleine. Fais de la\nplace puis reviens me voir.

entries.source_en: If you want your <0xFD>Á back,\nit will cost ¥<0xFD>Â.
entries.comparison_fr: Si tu veux récupérer ton {STR_VAR_1},\nça coûtera {STR_VAR_2}¥.

entries.source_en: Oh? But you have just one\nPokémon.<0xFB>Come back another time.
entries.comparison_fr: Oh ? Mais tu n’as qu’un seul\nPokémon.\pReviens une autre fois.

entries.source_en: Will you take your Pokémon back?
If you leave me that Pokémon,\nwhat will you battle with?<0xFB>Come back another time.
entries.comparison_fr: Si tu me laisses ce Pokémon, avec\nquoi vas-tu te battre ?\pReviens une autre fois.

entries.source_en: Outside the window"<0xFB>The sky looks fantastically\nbeautiful.
entries.comparison_fr: Par la fenêtre…\pLe ciel est d'une beauté\nfantastique.

It's a machine of some sort.\nIt sure is impressive.
It's the latest video game!\nIt sure looks fun!
entries.comparison_fr: Le dernier jeu vidéo !\nÇa a l’air amusant !

entries.source_en: There are obvious signs of burglary\nhere"
